l.i: Declinatio verbi actiui, primæ Conjugationis, Modus indicativ.

main_text.l: Io amo, ich lieb, ego amo.Tu amas, tu amas, du liebest.Colui ama, ille amat, er liebet.Noi amiamo, nos amamus, wir lieben.Voi amate, vos amatis, jhr liebet.Coloro amano, illi amant, sie lieben.

Io amana, ego amabam, ich liebete.Tu amaui, tu amabas, du liebetest.Colui amana, ille amabat, er liebete.Noi amauamo, nos amabamus, wir liebeten.Voi amauate, vos amabatis, jhr liebetet.Coloro amauano, illi amabant, sie liebeten.
Io amai, ego amaui, ich hab geliebt.Tu amasti, tu amauisti, du hast geliebt.Colui amò, ille amauit, er hat geliebt.

page.notes: Printed text is partly faint and show-through from the reverse page; some words (e.g. "Tu amai", "Colui ama") are uncertain. The word "Nos" at lower right is a catchword-like marker and is set in black letter-style type.
